name: @kabxx/dsh-message-revision
description: Edit and resend sent messages in place for DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.check: node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'; import { join } from 'node:path'; import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const files = []; for (const root of ['src', 'test']) for (const entry of readdirSync(root, { withFileTypes: true, recursive: true })) if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith('.js')) files.push(join(entry.parentPath, entry.name)); files.sort(); if (files.length === 0) process.exit(1); for (const file of files) { const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--check', file], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (r.error) throw r.error; if (r.status || r.signal) process.exit(r.status || 1); }"
